convert_prophetnet_checkpoint: convert a ProphetNet PyTorch checkpoint to the current HuggingFace Transformers model structure
convert_xprophetnet_checkpoint: convert an XLM-ProphetNet PyTorch checkpoint to the current HuggingFace Transformers model structure
run_convert_script_cli: run the convert_prophetnet script via CLI with checkpoint path and output folder arguments
map_prophetnet_weight_keys: map old ProphetNet weight keys to new HuggingFace Transformers layer names during conversion
split_in_proj_weights: split combined in_proj_weight and in_proj_bias into separate query, key, and value projection weights
